            "view_name": "vw_colaboradores_estructura_actual",
            "definition": " SELECT c.id AS colaborador_id,\n    c.tenant_id,\n    c.codigo_colaborador,\n    TRIM(BOTH FROM concat(c.nombres, ' ', COALESCE(c.apellidos, ''::character varying))) AS colaborador,\n    c.cargo,\n    cfg1.nombre_nivel AS etiqueta_nivel1,\n    u1.id AS nivel1_id,\n    u1.codigo AS nivel1_codigo,\n    u1.nombre AS nivel1_nombre,\n    cfg2.nombre_nivel AS etiqueta_nivel2,\n    u2.id AS nivel2_id,\n    u2.codigo AS nivel2_codigo,\n    u2.nombre AS nivel2_nombre,\n    cfg3.nombre_nivel AS etiqueta_nivel3,\n    u3.id AS nivel3_id,\n    u3.codigo AS nivel3_codigo,\n    u3.nombre AS nivel3_nombre,\n    cc3.id AS centro_costo_nivel3_id,\n    cc3.codigo AS centro_costo_nivel3_codigo,\n    cc3.nombre AS centro_costo_nivel3_nombre,\n    cd.dispositivo_id,\n    d.device_id,\n    d.kit_starlink,\n    ls.id AS linea_servicio_id,\n    ls.numero_linea,\n    ls.nombre AS servicio\n   FROM colaboradores c\n     JOIN colaborador_unidad_historial cu ON cu.colaborador_id = c.id AND cu.vigente_hasta IS NULL\n     JOIN unidades_organizacionales u3 ON u3.id = cu.unidad_nivel3_id\n     LEFT JOIN unidades_organizacionales u2 ON u2.id = u3.parent_id\n     LEFT JOIN unidades_organizacionales u1 ON u1.id = u2.parent_id\n     LEFT JOIN niveles_organizacion_config cfg1 ON cfg1.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cfg1.numero_nivel = 1\n     LEFT JOIN niveles_organizacion_config cfg2 ON cfg2.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cfg2.numero_nivel = 2\n     LEFT JOIN niveles_organizacion_config cfg3 ON cfg3.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND cfg3.numero_nivel = 3\n     LEFT JOIN unidad_centro_costo_historial uc3 ON uc3.unidad_id = u3.id AND uc3.vigente_hasta IS NULL\n     LEFT JOIN centros_costos cc3 ON cc3.id = uc3.centro_costo_id\n     LEFT JOIN colaborador_dispositivo_historial cd ON cd.colaborador_id = c.id AND cd.vigente_hasta IS NULL\n     LEFT JOIN dispositivos d ON d.id = cd.dispositivo_id\n     LEFT JOIN lineas_servicio ls ON ls.dispositivo_id = d.id\n  WHERE c.activo = true;",

            "definition": " SELECT c.tenant_id,\n    cd.linea_servicio_id,\n    to_char(cd.fecha_utc::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMM'::text) AS periodo,\n    sum(cd.priority_gb) AS priority_gb,\n    sum(cd.opt_in_priority_gb) AS opt_in_priority_gb,\n    sum(cd.standard_gb) AS standard_gb,\n    sum(cd.non_billable_gb) AS non_billable_gb,\n    sum(cd.priority_gb + cd.standard_gb + cd.non_billable_gb) AS total_gb\n   FROM consumo_diario cd\n     JOIN lineas_servicio ls ON ls.id = cd.linea_servicio_id\n     JOIN cuentas c ON c.id = ls.cuenta_id\n  GROUP BY c.tenant_id, cd.linea_servicio_id, (to_char(cd.fecha_utc::timestamp with time zone, 'YYYYMM'::text));",
